explication: 3X-UI KIT is a set of server-installation and administration scripts plus browser-based VPN configuration tools. The primary workflow installs 3X-UI on a VPS, then exposes protocol subscriptions tailored to client applications. A separate router workflow builds Xray or Mihomo configurations and an SSH command for XKeen or Nikki. The README also documents Hysteria2-only installation and server administration features. Relationships between the browser pages and generator modules are not shown in the excerpts, so those links are marked unverified; documented product workflows are retained.
